reason: I’ll follow the incoming gas into the nursery to see how it makes the surrounding gas shine.
expectation: The infalling gas may heat up and produce light, though I’m unsure of the mechanism.

alternatives.reason: The smaller system is also relevant, but I’ll investigate the nursery first.

effect: The nursery has produced fusion-powered young stars; combining them with the cloud fringe may now show how surrounding gas shines.
reaction: The distinction between contraction-powered light and sustained fusion is interesting.
reason: I’ll follow the young stars to see what they do to the nearby gas.
expectation: Their radiation may make the cloud fringe glow, though I’m unsure exactly how.

alternatives.reason: The smaller system also needs investigation, but I’ll finish following the nursery first.

effect: The nursery goal is complete; the remaining offered action follows gas into the smaller system.
reaction: The explanation of electrons being recaptured makes the glow mechanism clear.
reason: I'll take the only offered combination to investigate whether incoming gas stays in the smaller system.
expectation: The infalling gas may feed the disk while some escapes, though I don't know how.

effect: The smaller system now has a fusion-powered star and a disk; the remaining combination may show what happens to incoming gas.
reaction: The distinction between a dusty disk and a finished planetary system is useful.
reason: I'll follow the only offered combination to investigate whether all the incoming gas stays.
expectation: Some incoming gas may be expelled rather than joining the disk, though I don't know the mechanism.

effect: Some incoming gas escapes in a magnetically guided jet; the remaining combination follows that outflow into the hot bridge.
reaction: The connection between ongoing infall and an outward jet is interesting.
reason: I'll take the only offered combination to see what happens where the jet meets the bridge.
expectation: The jet may interact with and heat or disturb the bridge gas, though the result is uncertain.

effect: The jet shocks a portion of the bridge, producing glowing gas and completing the remaining goal.
reaction: The distinction between glowing shocked gas and another group of stars was useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the young stars into the cloud fringe was most worthwhile: it explained how ionized hydrogen produces the surrounding glow.

leastWorthwhile.text: The smaller star's formation felt less engaging as a separate step, since the result mostly established a disk before the outflow appeared.

surprise.text: I was interested that a star can continue taking in gas while launching some outward in a magnetically guided jet.

arbitrary.text: The final jet-and-bridge combination had a clear purpose, though the menu supplied the compatibility rather than requiring me to discover it. No action felt distinctly arbitrary.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the star and disk further, especially after seeing how the jet affects surrounding gas.
